parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, very deep S waves in V2-V3 and very tall R waves in V4-V5 (S in V2 + R in V5 well over 35 mm), and the mild concave ST elevation with upright T waves in V2-V3 fits LVH repolarization changes, with no reciprocal changes or convex ST elevation that would meet STEMI criteria.
